title: cross-functional-roadmap-sync-prep-feb-2026-personal-notes
content:
Goal: quick prep notes for 2/12 cross-functional roadmap alignment sync (Product + Eng + Applied ML). Draft personal scratchpad - informal.

Attendees (expected): Aisha (PM owner), Diego (Eng lead - serving runtime), Lena (Applied ML lead), Marcus (Product Ops), Priya (Release Eng), + optional: SRE rep if perf questions.

Agenda (rough):
- 5m quick wins since last sync (metrics + short status)
- 15m major risks/blockers for Q2 initiatives (dedicated + private)
- 20m model onboarding cadence & MLP prioritization (quantization / kernel work)
- 10m infra capacity planning: Dedicated pools + burst policy changes
- 10m rollouts + eval gating (how we measure quality regressions)
- 10m action items / owners / next steps

Prep notes / talking points:
- Quick wins:
  - Hosted API: baseline p50 latency down 8% (call out PR #894 kernel selection changes) - mention Diego
  - Small embedding cost improvement from caching prototype (benchmarks still noisy) - Lena to share microbench results after sync

- Major risks / blockers (need alignment):
  - Model onboarding backlog: applied-ml has 4 models queued where quantization recipe missing (INF-310). Impacts Dedicated launch schedule for customer pilot. Ask: can Eng triage one model/week?
  - Kernel coverage gaps: older architectures missing optimized kernels -> perf regressions on long sequences. Diego: estimate to fill critical kernels vs timeline (need commit for Q2 sprints)
  - Capacity planning for Dedicated: bookings > forecast for May - need to decide burst policy (reserve vs overcommit). Marcus to present high-level numbers.
  - Eval gating: No clear SLO for "acceptable regression" across model variants. Proposal: define per-route tolerances and automated rollback triggers in rollout pipeline. Priya to draft proposal.

- Model onboarding / prioritization heuristics (short brainstorm notes):
  - Prioritize models by: revenue potential (customer pilots), latency sensitivity, and memory footprint.
  - Quick filter: any model with >1GB memory AND used in low-latency route -> high priority for kernel/quantization work.
  - Consider "fast-path" onboarding: 1) smoke run on infra, 2) quantization recipe try, 3) perf patch if needed. Target 7-day cycle for non-critical models.

- Open questions to raise in sync (explicit ask / decision points):
  1) Does Eng commit to 1 model/week triage from Applied-ML backlog for Q2? (Diego)
  2) What are acceptable per-route regression thresholds for automatic rollback? Who owns these? (Product + SRE)
  3) Policy for Dedicated burst capacity: prefer higher guaranteed baseline or lower baseline + burst credit? (Finance input?)
  4) Do we want a cross-team "onboarding champion" rotation for faster handoffs? (operational suggestion)

- Data / artifacts to have ready:
  - Marcus: dedicated capacity bookings + forecast (spreadsheet)
  - Lena: microbench results for caching + quantization prototypes (short slides)
  - Diego: kernel gap list + rough ETA per kernel (bullet list)
  - Priya: initial rollout gating proposal doc (confluence stub linked above)

Action items I want to push in meeting (personal priorities):
- Confirm Eng commitment for triage cadence (ask Diego for a concrete sprint-level plan) -> owner: Diego; due: 2026-02-19
- Get Marcus to present capacity numbers and recommended burst policy options (have him share sheet 24h before) -> owner: Marcus; due: 2026-02-11 (send reminder)
- Request Lena share bench CSV + short notes post-sync; capture if caching is ready to A/B on Hosted routes -> owner: Lena; due: 2026-02-16
- Ask Priya to draft rollback thresholds + who owns gating rules; propose canary windows + automatic fallback plan -> owner: Priya; due: 2026-02-18
- Create follow-up doc with agreed decisions and assign tickets to teams (I'll own doc + initially triage tickets) -> owner: Aisha; due: 2026-02-13

Notes to self / talking style:
- Keep ask very concrete ("can we do X by date Y"), avoid abstract debates.
- If Eng pushes back on bandwidth, propose "pilot" subset: 2 high-priority models to start.
- Emphasize customer impact: explicit pilot customers waiting for Dedicated model support.

Rough timeline considerations (for sync to align on):
- Feb: align on triage cadence + capacity policy
- Mar: start kernel work + onboard first pilot models
- Apr/May: scale Dedicated customer pilots + ramp capacity; monitor costs with Redwood Optimize suggestions

Meeting runbook items (for meeting owner / Ops):
- Share slide: 1 slide each for wins, blockers, asks (total 5 slides)
- Keep parking lot for deep technical kernel discussion (do separately with runtime team)
- Record decisions in Confluence page (link above) and create follow-up Jira epics/tickets immediately after sync

Follow-ups after meeting (my immediate next steps):
- Send summary email with decisions + action owners within 24h -> include linked tickets and deadlines
- Create epics for kernel work and onboarding pipeline if agreed
- Chase Marcus for capacity sheet if not posted

Rough draft of email summary (copyable):
"Thanks everyone for the sync. Key decisions: Eng will triage onboarding backlog at 1 model/week for Q2 (Diego), Priya will draft rollback thresholds and gating rules, Marcus will present capacity options and recommended burst policy, Lena to share bench results. Action owners + due dates attached. I'll post decision doc and link tickets by EOD 2/13. If you disagree with assignments, reply-all."

Notes / scratch (stuff I might mention verbally):
- If kernel fill timeline slips, propose fallbacks: temporary model variant or small param swap for latency-sensitive routes.
- Suggest running small A/B on Hosted API routes with caching enabled for one week to validate perf/cost assumptions.

Unresolved / parking lot:
- Need finance input on burst pricing impact (Marcus to loop in finance contact)
- Need legal review for private/on-prem pilot contracts (Customer Success to pick up)

End of notes.

-- Aisha

(rough, incomplete - copy to Confluence after decisions)
